scope: Generic interaction tests, traceable corrections, retained evidence reads and bounded tool recovery

changes.correction: Host-verified intended-target replacement with identical assertions, setup and revision; append-only supersession
changes.evidenceRead: Task-scoped Play observation ranges, stale labels, screenshot metadata and retained image reference

focused.toolFlow: Wrong target → failed formal case → passing probe → traceable correction → read retained state after Stop → acceptance pass
focused.durability: Real Operation Log close/reopen; original artifacts and failed verdict retained

failures.diagnostic: Existing frozen CPU identity gate: expected i7-7700 / 8 logical CPUs, actual i7-14700KF / 28; gate unchanged

secretScan.limitation: Pattern and configured-value scan of generated files; no real credential store is read. A zero crash-dump count means no dump was generated.
